rfam.comment: This family represents the Flavivirus 3'-SL cis-acting replication element (CRE). The family is thought to play a crucial role in replication and is thought to be needed for the formation of a "replication complex" [1]. Although evidence has been presented for an existence of a pseudoknot structure in this RNA [2], it does not appear to be well conserved across flaviviruses. Deletions of the 3' UTR of flaviviruses have been shown to be lethal for infectious clones.
